# --instructions--

各キーが単語の長さ（数値）で、その値がその長さを持つすべての単語を`words`に現れる順に並べた配列である`Map`を返す関数`groupByLength(words)`を書いてください

# --asserts--

`groupByLength(["sun", "moon", "sky", "star"])`は`3`を`["sun", "sky"]`に対応させるべきです

```javascript
tryCatch(JSON.stringify(groupByLength(["sun", "moon", "sky", "star"]).get(3)) === '["sun","sky"]');
```

`groupByLength(["sun", "moon", "sky", "star"])`は`4`を`["moon", "star"]`に対応させるべきです

```javascript
tryCatch(JSON.stringify(groupByLength(["sun", "moon", "sky", "star"]).get(4)) === '["moon","star"]');
```

キーは数値であるべきなので、`get("3")`は`undefined`を返すべきです

```javascript
tryCatch(groupByLength(["sun", "moon", "sky", "star"]).get("3") === undefined);
```

`groupByLength([])`は`0`個のペアを持つべきです

```javascript
tryCatch(groupByLength([]).size === 0);
```

# --solutions--

```javascript
function groupByLength(words) {
  let groups = new Map();
  for (const word of words) {
    if (!groups.has(word.length)) {
      groups.set(word.length, []);
    }
    groups.get(word.length).push(word);
  }
  return groups;
}
```
